comments: The scratch-session companion to plan-cold-open.json: the lane's OWN stored
remote session (created on cloud-node-1, one completed turn, then stopped so
the owner's runtime is down) opened COLD and held for a minute - no send, no
warm, and never the operator's sessions. $SESSION comes from
Expected on the fix: placeholder holds the whole minute (or the honest
'Earlier history not loaded' arm once rows exist), rows stay 0 while the
owner is down, greeting never appears, startCopy never appears - an unproven
hydration is never presented as the conversation's end or as emptiness.

steps.js: (() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ""; const q = (re) => re.test(t) ? "yes" : "no"; return { hash: location.hash, rows: document.querySelectorAll("[data-record-id]").length, placeholder: q(/Loading conversation/), greeting: q(/What can I help you with today/), startCopy: q(/Start of conversation/), notLoaded: q(/Earlier history not loaded|Earlier not loaded/), chip: (document.querySelector("[data-device-chip]")?.innerText || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 60) }; })()
